title: Rabbah bar Yosef bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: “Rav Sheshet said” — so it is in Bava Metzia 70a; but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “Rav Yosef bar Chama said that Rav Sheshet said,” for he was in fact his student.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Bava Metzia 70a has Rabbah bar Shila reporting Rav Chisda, alternatively Rabbah bar Yosef bar Chama reporting Rav Sheshet. Hyman proposes dropping Rabbah bar from the latter transmitter and identifies Rav Yosef bar Chama as Rav Sheshet’s student; that remains his argument.
The proposed correction and the teacher–student explanation remain Hyman’s argument; the consulted passage retains the longer transmitter name as noted above.
